audit.whatIsWrong: This direction's chart reads Wukong / Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser in both layers. The mirror (audits/top/mordekaiser__wukong.json) was set as an atomic group to Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Wukong, which is also exactly packet.levelChart. Four rows disagree with the mirror.
audit.why: Three independent signals agree against the current rows: packet.levelChart, the mirror's approved chart, and this page's own whys — whys[0] says 'Even opener', whys[3] says 'Even at four', whys[6] says 'Late you flip it', none of which match the sides currently stored. 47.77% over 471 games supports a Mordekaiser-leaning middle with an even start and a Wukong late.
audit.corrected: Flipped rows 0, 1, 3 and 6 in BOTH layers as one atomic paired group (phases[N].side + win[N] together), and moved the four ratings with them: row 0 to 5/10 Skill, row 1 to 4/10 Mordekaiser, row 3 to 5/10 Skill, row 6 to 6/10 Wukong. Rows 2, 4 and 5 already matched the mirror and are untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike text describes his shield as a passive ('his passive shield', 'Indignation (E... his shield passive)'), which fuses three different abilities into one.
audit.why: Darkness Rise (P) is a damage aura that comes online after three hits; Indestructible (W) is the stored-damage shield he can convert to healing on a 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown; Death's Grasp (E) is a pull. Timing your commit correctly needs those separated, because you fight through the W and around the E.
audit.corrected: Named Indestructible as the shield in spikes[0] and spikes[2], kept every 'when' where it was, and left the four-entry spikes array intact.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Indignation (E... his shield passive)' is not an ability Mordekaiser has — the parenthetical is visibly a guess left on the page. dontsFull[1] is headed 'Stand in his E' but its body text ('Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown') describes nothing in the matchup.
audit.why: The E is Death's Grasp, a 700-range pull on 16/14/12/10/8s. That pull is what starts every Morde trade, so the don't needs to describe walking around it and the punish window after it.
audit.corrected: Replaced the fabricated name with Indestructible, and rewrote dontsFull[1].d around Death's Grasp's real range and cooldown. Added Obliterate's 675 range and 8/7/6/5/4s cooldown and Realm of Death's 650 range and 140/120/100s to the cooldown lines.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Realm of Death as matchup-defining but carried no number for it or for anything else.
audit.why: 140 seconds at rank 1 is the longest window in the lane and it is the only cooldown that decides whether you can commit.
audit.corrected: Real numbers for R, Q and E written into breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t.

audit.why: Indestructible converts the stored shield into healing, so the existing Executioner's Calling line in report[8].t is genuinely earned, not boilerplate.

notes: The kit file tags Obliterate with a 'grounding' flag, but Riot's own description of Obliterate is damage only and says nothing about grounding — per the rule that the description wins over a misfiring derived flag, I did not write anywhere that his Q stops your dashes. If that flag is correct it would change the whole matchup (Nimbus Strike and the clone dash both shut off), so it is worth a human check. Also unstated because the data cannot settle it: whether Cyclone's knockup can displace him out of Realm of Death, and whether Realm of Death is QSS-able. The mirror's note that ownerKit is null for this pair applies here too — this brief carries no Wukong ability text, so I added no new mechanical claim about Wukong's own kit.
